_doc: Music inserts: in a script — in the SFX line, "MUSIC: <mood>, <seconds>s" or with a manual mark "MUSIC: <mood>, 8s, A@41.5". The mood is found by keys; anchor start — a piece from at onwards, end — a piece that ends at at. Tracks are your own files under channels/<channel>/assets/music/ (not in git). The example has no tracks.
